description: Negotiate and enforce screen time contracts with children using a fair AI-mediated system. Set per-child daily limits, create educational vs entertainment budgets, track actual usage, generate compliance report cards, and auto-grant/extend time for chores, homework, and good behavior.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent implement the requested change with minimal unrelated edits?
Did the agent verify behavior changes instead of relying on intuition?
